name: W Brisbane
positioning: A riverside hotel in the heart of Brisbane's CBD with a heated fourth-floor pool, AWAY Spa and suites with panoramic Brisbane River views
best_for: City travelers who want river views and walkable access to Queen Street Mall, South Bank and QAGOMA
Guests who want a suite with a river view and a deep soaking tub

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Brisbane's CBD, overlooking the Brisbane River.
Curvilinear shapes inspired by the river run through the hotel's design.
Penthouse I is on the top floor with panoramic views of the Brisbane River to the mountains.
Penthouse I has a fully equipped bar and a large dining space.
Penthouse II has a separate living room, a dining area and a bathtub with a dual shower.
The FIT gym on Level Six has Brisbane skyline views and TechnoGym equipment.
The WET Deck rooftop bar offers sunsets, handcrafted cocktails, light bites and DJ sets.
A music curator and resident DJ play the Living Room Bar and WET Deck weekly.
South Bank is about a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
The Queensland Art Gallery and Gallery of Modern Art (QAGOMA) is just across the river.
Queen Street Mall is a 600-meter walk from the hotel.

highlights.text: The heated WET pool on the fourth floor has panoramic views of Brisbane City.
Each suite offers panoramic Brisbane River views.
Suites have a 10-gallon drum bathtub with bath treatments by Retreatment Botanics.
AWAY Spa on Level Five offers body treatments and relaxation pods.
The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange a helicopter ride to Byron Bay, a rugby game from an exclusive box or a lesson with a pro surfer.

considerations.text: One pet is allowed per room, up to 18 kg.
Self-parking is in a third-party garage in the same precinct.
WhataHotel notes it is an urban hotel rather than a resort.
